source_caption:
📺 The Chosen (2017–Present)

The Chosen follows the life of Jesus Christ through the eyes of the people who encounter Him, offering a powerful and emotional look at one of history’s most influential stories. Set in first-century Israel, the series explores the lives of ordinary people, including fishermen, tax collectors, religious leaders, and those searching for hope and purpose. As Jesus begins His ministry, He brings together a diverse group of followers whose lives are transformed by His teachings, compassion, and miracles. Through personal struggles, unexpected friendships, and moments of faith, the series explores forgiveness, sacrifice, love, and the challenges of following a greater calling.

🎭 Genre: Historical Drama • Biography • Faith

⭐ IMDb: 9.2/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 40–60 minutes per episode • TV-PG

🎥 Creator: Dallas Jenkins

📺 Where to Watch: Prime Video and The Chosen app in the United States. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: The Chosen is an American Christian historical drama television series, created, directed, and co-written by filmmaker Dallas Jenkins. It is the first multi-season series about the life and ministry of Jesus of Nazareth, primarily set in Judaea and Galilee in the first century. The series depicts Jesus's life through the eyes of the people who interacted with him, including the apostles and disciples of Jesus, Jewish religious leaders, Roman government and military officials, and ordinary people.
